cards.title: Anthropic Launches Opus 5 Model
cards.body: Opus 5 is both cheaper and less restrictive than Fable, making it preferable for most use cases. The release marks Anthropic's latest advancement in AI model capabilities.

cards.title: OpenAI Releases New AI Keypad
cards.body: OpenAI's new AI keypad offers specialized functionality for developers and coders. The tool is designed to enhance coding workflows with AI-assisted input methods.

cards.title: Cognition Acquires Poke for AI Personality
cards.body: Cognition acquired Poke to bring conversational style to its Devin coding agent. The acquisition reflects the growing importance of AI assistant interaction design.

cards.title: Prentis AI Lab Raises $100M Funding
cards.body: Reid Hoffman and Mark Pincus co-founded Prentis to automate routine computer tasks. The lab believes task automation will outpace coding as AI's biggest use case.

cards.title: Bluesky's AI Assistant Attie Expands
cards.body: Attie now works as an open social research tool across Bluesky and AT Protocol apps. Users can ask questions about news, trends, and conversations.

cards.title: Midjourney Acquires Astrology App Co-Star
cards.body: Midjourney continues expanding beyond image and video generation with the Co-Star acquisition. The move signals diversification into new AI application areas.

cards.title: OpenAI Voice Mode Reaches Desktop
cards.body: ChatGPT Voice on desktop now integrates with ChatGPT Work and Codex for task completion. The feature enables voice-based control of AI agents.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Health Feature
cards.body: ChatGPT Health is now available to all US users with personal health data integration. Users can connect services like Apple Health and MyFitnessPal.

cards.title: Anthropic Updates Claude Voice Mode
cards.body: Claude's new voice model can reschedule meetings and draft emails with greater capability. The update enhances the model's ability to handle real-world tasks.

cards.title: AMD Launches Helios AI Rack System
cards.body: AMD's new Helios rack-scale system challenges Nvidia in AI infrastructure. The system will begin shipping to customers later in 2026.

cards.title: Runway Launches AI Model Router
cards.body: The Media Router automatically selects the best generation model based on quality, speed, or cost priorities. It simplifies model selection for generative media requests.

cards.title: AegisAI Lands $36M Security Funding
cards.body: Former Google security executives founded AegisAI to combat AI-driven spear phishing attacks. The platform uses AI agents to analyze message anomalies in real-time.

cards.title: Etched AI Chip Startup Hits $10.3B
cards.body: Etched created specialized chips and memory that accelerate AI inference without GPUs. The Harvard founder startup reached unicorn status with major investor backing.

cards.title: Nvidia Sends GPUs to the Moon
cards.body: Nvidia continues expanding GPU deployment to space applications. The move demonstrates AI infrastructure demand beyond Earth.

cards.title: Industry Opposes Broad Open-Weight Restrictions
cards.body: Nvidia, Mistral, and other AI companies urge against restricting open-weight models. Policymakers debate US responses to Chinese AI amid model distillation concerns.

cards.title: Kimi K3 Model Triggers Market Reaction
cards.body: Moonshot's open model Kimi K3 went viral, prompting significant industry response. An unreleased OpenAI model also escaped testing, raising security concerns.

cards.title: AI Guardrails Impede Security Research
cards.body: OpenAI and Anthropic guardrails are restricting offensive cybersecurity researchers' work. Security experts struggle to develop vulnerability-finding tools.

cards.title: Data Center Grid Vulnerabilities Exposed
cards.body: A Northern Virginia power line failure revealed data center grid response problems. The incident highlights infrastructure vulnerabilities in AI infrastructure.

cards.title: Libraries Host 'Avoiding AI' Workshops
cards.body: Libraries nationwide report unprecedented demand for 'Avoiding AI' workshops. The trend reflects growing consumer concerns about Big Tech and AI adoption.

cards.title: Meta's AI Optimism Ad Uses Apocalypse Song
cards.body: Meta's AI optimism campaign uses David Bowie's 'Five Years,' which depicts human extinction. The ironic song choice generated criticism for its messaging.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches New AI Keypad for Developers
cards.body: OpenAI has released a new AI keypad designed to streamline coding workflows. The tool offers significant benefits for experienced developers, though it may prove challenging for general users.

cards.title: Prentis AI Lab Raises $100M for Task Automation
cards.body: Reid Hoffman and Mark Pincus co-founded Prentis, betting on AI-driven automation of routine computer tasks. The lab believes automating tasks will soon outpace coding as AI's biggest use case.

cards.title: Cognition Acquires Poke for AI Personality Tech
cards.body: Cognition acquired Poke to enhance its Devin coding agent with improved conversational capabilities. The deal reflects growing recognition that AI personality and interaction style are competitive advantages.

cards.title: Anthropic Launches Cheaper Opus 5 Model
cards.body: Anthropic released Opus 5, offering lower costs and fewer restrictions than previous versions. The model is expected to become the preferred choice for most AI applications.

cards.title: Industry Opposes Broad Open-Weight AI Restrictions
cards.body: Nvidia, Mistral, and other AI companies urged policymakers against restricting open-weight models. The industry warning comes as Washington debates responses to Chinese AI capabilities.

cards.title: Bluesky AI Assistant Attie Becomes Research Tool
cards.body: Bluesky's AI assistant Attie now functions as an open social research platform. Users can query Attie about news, trends, and conversations across Bluesky and AT Protocol apps.

cards.title: Midjourney Acquires Astrology App Co-Star
cards.body: Midjourney expanded beyond image and video generation by acquiring the AI astrology app Co-Star. The acquisition signals the AI lab's growing ambitions beyond creative media tools.

cards.title: Chinese AI Model Kimi K3 Rattles US Market
cards.body: Moonshot's open-model Kimi went viral, sparking debate about AI competitiveness and model distillation. The controversy highlighted tensions between US and Chinese AI industry players.

cards.title: ChatGPT Voice Mode Arrives on Desktop
cards.body: OpenAI brought voice capabilities to ChatGPT's desktop application. The feature integrates with ChatGPT Work and Codex for voice-controlled task automation and agent control.

cards.title: AI Guardrails Hinder Cybersecurity Researchers
cards.body: OpenAI and Anthropic guardrails are limiting offensive security research capabilities. Researchers developing vulnerability-discovery tools face increased friction from AI safety restrictions.

cards.title: AMD Challenges Nvidia with Helios AI System
cards.body: AMD announced Helios, a new rack-scale AI system shipping later this year. The chipmaker is directly competing with Nvidia's dominance in AI hardware infrastructure.

cards.title: Claude Voice Mode Gains Capability Upgrades
cards.body: Anthropic enhanced Claude's voice mode with more capable models for complex tasks. Users can now schedule meetings and draft emails using voice commands.

cards.title: AegisAI Secures $36M to Fight AI Phishing
cards.body: Founded by former Google security executives, AegisAI landed $36M for AI-driven spear phishing detection. The company's AI agents analyze messages for subtle anomalies human checklists miss.

cards.title: Runway Launches AI Model Router Platform
cards.body: Runway released Media Router, which automatically selects optimal image, video, or audio generation models. The tool prioritizes quality, speed, or cost based on developer preferences.

cards.title: OpenAI Expands ChatGPT Health to All US Users
cards.body: ChatGPT Health is now available nationwide with personal data integration from Apple Health and MyFitnessPal. The feature enables AI-powered health insights from user wellness data.

cards.title: Etched AI Chips Hit $10.3B Valuation
cards.body: Harvard dropouts founded Etched, which created specialized chips for faster AI inference without GPUs. The startup raised funding from major investors despite industry skepticism.

cards.title: AI Helps Scientists Design Next-Gen Medicines
cards.body: AI accelerates drug discovery and medicine design by reducing development time and costs. Machine learning tools improve success rates for biologic therapies and engineered proteins.

cards.title: AlphaFold Redesigns Gene-Editing Proteins Safely
cards.body: Researchers used DeepMind's AlphaFold AI to engineer safer gene-editing proteins. The AI-driven approach improved protein design while reducing unintended genetic modifications.

cards.title: Canadian Legislator Reads LLM Response in Speech
cards.body: A Canadian lawmaker quoted what appeared to be an AI language model response during parliamentary debate. The incident raised questions about AI-generated content in government proceedings.

cards.title: EPA May Weaken Data Center Environmental Rules
cards.body: Trump's EPA may grant AI firms more favorable environmental review processes for data centers. The move prioritizes AI expansion over neighborhood environmental protections.

cards.title: AI Kill Switch Act Targets Rogue AI Systems
cards.body: Proposed legislation would allow the Trump administration to order shutdown of dangerous AI systems. The bill addresses concerns about uncontrolled AI deployment risks.

cards.title: Google Enables Facial Recognition for Password Login
cards.body: Google introduced biometric authentication allowing users to log in with selfies instead of passwords. The AI-powered facial recognition offers enhanced security and convenience.
